t: Data is the new oil, and most organizations are sitting on a well they never drill.
Scaling is not about doing more, it's about doing the same quality of work across more contexts.
Growth exposes every gap you choose not to document.
Do not allow your organization's sustainability to be built on one funder's generosity.
The ceiling of your organization is the ceiling of your home growth.
You cannot afford to treat knowledge management as an administrative afterthought.
Recognition can masquerade as a rival, and words are not the same as systems.
In 2019, when we designed our foundational learning program, I was obsessed with one question,
how do we keep what we learn?
I went back to school, to the University of Geneva and New York University, because what I knew was no longer enough.
Let me tell you something I learned the hard way, in my very first year of running this organization.
Over the last decade, I have watched brilliant funders burn out, not because of their lacked passion, but because of their lacked systems.
So let me ask you, what happens to your organization if you disappear for six months?
Have you ever thought of what you would do when you do not have access to funding?
Have you ever lost the funder overnight? How did that feel?
Honestly, that was one of the proudest moments of my career.
Wait, read that again. One funding source is not a strategy.
And that, my friend, is exactly why most leaders get stuck. That, my friend, is why many funders get stuck.
